basemap.source: Made with Natural Earth, public domain 1:110m land geometry

projection: Flat 2:1 normalized display geography; shared aspect ratio is a preview assumption, not a verified identical affine geotransform.
limitations: Flat 2:1 source field aspect ratios are used for display; common longitude extent does not imply a verified identical geotransform.
Different scientific variables, palettes, spatial coverage and acquisition times cannot be merged numerically here. The map is exploratory composition.
Intact CO/NOx/temperature source fields retain their colors and pixel scope; uniform user-selectable opacity does not drop scientific subregions.
